name: GridSchool
title: Building the school, on its own map
label: The school runs on the same law
focus: Phase 0: rails are on GitHub. Next: AWS staging, then the world is reachable.
next: Create the gridschool-deploy AWS key, stand up Lightsail staging, point play.gridschool.org.

nodes.title: The name is real
nodes.desc: The world lives at play.gridschool.org. No second brand until a first student. Internal name: the grid. Lights when the URL resolves.

nodes.title: Repos renamed + rails
nodes.desc: gridschool-world-server and -client, public to read, MIT. CI green, PR ceremony, branch protection on main.

nodes.title: Missions seeded
nodes.desc: GF-1 through GF-7 plus two features, each with done_when, live as GitHub Issues.

nodes.title: Staging is live
nodes.desc: Merge to main auto-deploys the world to AWS Lightsail. /health 200, websocket 101 verified 2026-08-26.

nodes.title: The world is watchable
nodes.desc: WebGL client on S3/CloudFront. A friend clicks a link and stands in the Grid.

nodes.title: Onboarding survives a stranger
nodes.desc: Clean machine, 45 minutes or less, followed by someone who is not Aden.

nodes.title: Student zero defended
nodes.desc: Aden runs GF-1 with full ceremony. One external engineer answers the reader form.

nodes.title: Episode 1 is live
nodes.desc: Organic lane. Market, promise vs reality, ownership. Soft CTA only.

nodes.title: The funnel is wired
nodes.desc: VSL on the apply flow. Stripe, Cal.com, Discord connected. Separate lane from YouTube.

nodes.title: The ad test runs
nodes.desc: Small capped Instagram test into the VSL. Only after the world is live.

nodes.title: A student is in the world
nodes.desc: First paid seat. Their week 1 looks like every future student's week 1.

nodes.title: Five defenses, outside verdicts
nodes.desc: The gate that raises the price and opens the next cohort.
